name: TDE Fab

about:
TDE Fabrication operates from Lakeland, Minnesota, near the Twin Cities metropolitan area. The company was founded by Andrew Tange and Jake Liedtke, both graduates of the University of Wisconsin system. Tange earned a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from UW–Milwaukee and developed a passion for metalworking and product invention, while Liedtke studied engineering at UW–Platteville before building a career in customer service and sales. Their combined backgrounds in engineering and design led them to establish a custom metalworking shop focused on architectural metal features.

The shop produces custom architectural metalwork for residential and commercial projects across the Midwest. Its portfolio includes floating staircases, interior and exterior railings, statement fireplace surrounds and mantels, pergolas and outdoor shade structures, and decorative metal panels. The team handles design renderings, site measurements, in-house fabrication, and final installation, offering a seamless process from concept to completion.

TDE Fabrication serves home builders, designers, architects, and general contractors throughout the Twin Cities region, including communities such as Minnetonka, Chanhassen, Stillwater, Wayzata, Edina, and Shakopee. The company collaborates with these professionals to deliver structural and decorative metal elements that integrate with broader building projects.

The founders emphasize four pillars that distinguish the business: every project receives a custom design tailored to the client's style and functional needs; craftsmanship combines advanced fabrication techniques with artisan-level attention to detail; a collaborative process keeps builders, designers, and contractors involved from concept through installation; and only premium metals and finishes are used to ensure lasting performance.
